entry.title: Product of the Day — Golden Bible
entry.content:
The Golden Bible is a sacred tome bound in edible gold leaf and infused with the essence of sunflowers. Its pages contain ancient wisdom inscribed by an unknown scribe using a quill dipped in stardust. As readers devour its contents, they absorb not only knowledge but also fleeting bursts of creativity and temporary resistance to gravity.
When held aloft during sermons, the book's weight adjusts according to congregation attendance; less faithful listeners are met with heavier volumes, discouraging slumber. Copies have been known to self-correct errors, rewriting passages to better fit audience comprehension levels.
Categories: books

entry.title: Product of the Day — Money Laundry Machine
entry.content:
The Money Laundry Machine is a high-tech appliance designed to cleanse financial documents of their original intent. Feed in a stack of invoices, receipts, and bank statements, and this machine will neutralize any evidence of purchases, transactions, or investments. The resulting output appears identical yet contains contradictory information, perfect for befuddling auditors and creditors alike.
When operated correctly, the machine hums softly, emitting a faint scent reminiscent of freshly laundered socks. Excess lint generated during processing collects within an easily removable compartment labeled 'Lost Income'.
